# FRAME: habits for rotating shifts
## Job statement
When my shift pattern changes, a shift worker wants to keep two daily habits, so they can stay healthy.
## Problem
How might we keep habits stable for rotating-shift workers so that they survive rota changes?
## Audience / boundary
Hospital and factory shift workers on rotating rotas.
## Success looks like
NOT VERIFIED
## Hard constraints
- No wearable devices
## Soft constraints
- Works on a basic phone
## Non-goals
- Sleep medicine
## Criteria
| criterion | weight | 1 = | 3 = | 5 = |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value | 30 | no pain relieved | some pain | removes the pain |
| Feasibility | 25 | needs research | months | weeks |
| Fit | 20 | off-mission | partial | core |
| Distinctiveness | 15 | the obvious answer | some distance | far from obvious |
| Evidence | 10 | none | anecdotes | data |
## Axes
- Moment: before shift | during break | after shift
- Channel: phone | paper | colleague
- Habit: sleep | food | movement
